SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND, PROCE_STATE_CD FROM KEPMPRQ02 WHERE CSTMR_ID IN ('KRHSDE0003C001') AND SND_CHK = 'N' AND PROCE_STATE_CD = 'RE05' AND GDS_TYP_CD = 'C' AND CTLG_REGST_CHK = 'Y' ORDER BY CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT REPLACE(replace(RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO,rq02.cstmr_id,'')||RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ,'RE','') as INTERFACE_HEADER_ID , TO_NUMBER(RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ) AS LINE_NUM , RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND AS REVISION , 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE , RQ03.SLS_UNTPRC AS UNIT_PRICE , 16590 AS CATEGORY_ID , nvl(RQ02.GDS_CD ,' ') as BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 RQ02, KEPCON.KEPMPRQ04 RQ04, KEPCON.KEPMPRQ03 RQ03 WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$ AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RE_NO AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ= RQ04.QUOTA_RE_SEQ AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND= RQ04.QUOTA_RE_RND AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_NO AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ= RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_RND= RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_RND AND RQ03.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND RQ04.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND RQ03.SUBID_CHK = 'Y'
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
